newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine SEC halts operations of brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Philippine SEC halts operations of brokerage.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of the Philippines on Friday ordered brokerage Griffin Securities Corporation to halt operations until informed otherwise.

The SEC said in an order that Manila-based Griffin, formerly known as Moore Mckenzie Inc, had violated several SEC rules and regulations and was the subject of complaints from investors in the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore and Australia.
It said also that the brokerage had a net capital deficiency of over 108 million pesos as of June 30, 1996 and had failed to deliver customers' securities on demand.
The SEC ordered Griffin's officers and directors to appear before it on February 24 to show cause why its licence should not be cancelled.
